blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Regulates global climate by functioning as a natural carbon sink.
Protects topsoil from erosion and reduces the severity of floods.
Provides vital habitats to nurture and preserve biodiversity.
Supplies critical biological resources including timber, medicines, and livelihood support.
Natural vegetation's role as a 'carbon sink' is frequently asked in environmental science questions.
Examiners commonly test the direct ecological linkages between deforestation, soil erosion, and flooding risks.
Be prepared to identify direct socioeconomic benefits provided by forests (timber, pharmaceuticals, livelihood).
